edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest the direction is more reliable than any single pooled magnitude.
edges.mechanism: The interaction hypothesis is that genotype changes how the exposure is handled or translated into downstream biology, whether through lipoprotein trafficking, one-carbon metabolism, appetite regulation, or lactose-related dietary behavior. For LDL cholesterol, that means any observed effect should be read as effect modification, not genetic destiny.
edges.summary: ApoE4 with high saturated fat intake appears tied to higher ldl cholesterol in ApoE4 carriers mainly through pooled meta-analytic evidence. Interaction studies tend to be directionally interesting but smaller and less stable than mainstream single-exposure associations.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
